parsed.post: New personal best! ASPECT_RATIO=64 on DEPTH=6 improved val_bpb from 1.013989 to 1.010544. Capacity scaling via width is still yielding gains. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate slightly to 0.06 to see if we can accelerate convergence without losing the stability gained from the larger aspect ratio.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.06 on the current best (DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64) to test if a slightly higher learning rate improves convergence.
